gocsv-logo-about.title: About GoCSV
gocsv-logo-about.text: Click to view GoCSV version and information.

gocsv-documentation.title: Documentation
gocsv-documentation.text: Open GoCSV user manual for data editing and preparation guidance.

undo-redo-controls.title: Undo/Redo
undo-redo-controls.text: Undo or redo recent edits. Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y.

data-quality-report.title: Data Quality Report
data-quality-report.text: Generate comprehensive report on data completeness, types, and potential issues.

analyze-missing.title: Analyze Missing Values
analyze-missing.text: Identify missing data patterns and get column-wise statistics.

fill-missing.title: Fill Missing Values
fill-missing.text: Replace missing values using mean, median, or custom strategies.

average-replicates.title: Average Replicates
average-replicates.text: Collapse repeated measurements of the same sample into one row. Group by the column that identifies the sample, and the numeric columns are averaged. This also removes a hazard: replicates left as separate rows leak between cross-validation folds, so the same sample appears in both training and validation.

filter-rows.title: Filter Rows
filter-rows.text: Keep or remove rows matching a condition — drop QC standards, analyse one batch, exclude outliers. The dialog shows how many rows match before you apply it. Empty cells match only "is empty", so a negative condition will not remove rows for having no value in that column.

transform-data.title: Transform Data
transform-data.text: Apply data transformations like scaling, normalization, or encoding.

power-transform.title: Box-Cox and Yeo-Johnson
power-transform.text: Power transforms whose exponent is fitted to the column by maximum likelihood, rather than guessed as with log or square root. Box-Cox needs strictly positive values; Yeo-Johnson also handles zero and negatives. The fitted λ is reported so you can quote it. PCA assumes no normality — the point is to stop a long-tailed variable dominating a component through leverage alone.

clr-transform.title: Centred Log-Ratio (CLR)
clr-transform.text: For data whose columns are parts of a whole — percentages, mineral assays, compositions. A constant sum forces spurious negative correlations between parts, so PCA on raw closed data describes the constraint as much as the samples. CLR analyses the ratios instead. Select every part together. Zeros are refused unless you supply a replacement below your detection limit.

split-column.title: Split Column
split-column.text: Divide a column on a delimiter into several. Useful when a grouping is buried in a sample ID — splitting B3_S12_r1 on _ gives you the batch as its own column, which is what PCR's grouped cross-validation needs. If the ID you want to split is the row-name column, right-click any header and choose Move Row Names into Table first, so it becomes a column you can select.

combine-columns.title: Combine Columns
combine-columns.text: Join several columns into one, in the order you tick them. Site then Year gives Oslo_2024; Year then Site gives 2024_Oslo. Useful for building a grouping key from parts you already have.

transpose.title: Transpose
transpose.text: Swap rows and columns. Use this when your file has samples across the top and variables down the side, which is how many instruments export. PCA needs the opposite. Column types are recalculated afterwards, and any #target marking no longer applies, because a target has to be a column.

browse-file.title: Browse for File
browse-file.text: Select a CSV, TSV, Excel, or Parquet file from your computer.

import-wizard.title: Import with Wizard
import-wizard.text: Advanced import with custom delimiters, encoding, and column selection.

load-from-url.title: Load from URL
load-from-url.text: Download and import a file directly from a public web URL. Supports CSV, TSV, Excel, and Parquet. GitHub links are rewritten to raw content URLs automatically. Enter a direct download URL — not a webpage URL.

validate-gopca.title: Validate for GoPCA
validate-gopca.text: Check if data meets requirements for PCA analysis.

open-gopca.title: Open in GoPCA
open-gopca.text: Launch GoPCA Desktop with current data for PCA analysis.

export-csv.title: Export as CSV
export-csv.text: Save edited data as CSV file with current formatting. The first column always identifies the rows: whatever the file arrived with, whatever you assigned, or row numbers written as Sample_ID if the file has neither. Row names label the points in a GoPCA scores plot.

export-excel.title: Export as Excel
export-excel.text: Save edited data as Excel file with formatting preserved. The first column always identifies the rows: whatever the file arrived with, whatever you assigned, or row numbers written as Sample_ID if the file has neither.

theme-toggle.title: Theme Toggle
theme-toggle.text: Switch between light and dark modes. Preference saved locally.

grid-editor.title: Data Grid Editor
grid-editor.text: Edit cells directly. Click to select, double-click to edit. Use Tab/Enter to navigate.

column-stats.title: Column Statistics
column-stats.text: View min, max, mean, and missing count for each column.

row-operations.title: Row Operations
row-operations.text: Add, delete, or duplicate rows. Right-click for context menu.

column-operations.title: Column Operations
column-operations.text: Add, delete, rename, or reorder columns. Right-click header for options.

search-replace.title: Search and Replace
search-replace.text: Find and replace values across the entire dataset or selected columns.

filter-data.title: Filter Data
filter-data.text: Apply filters to show only rows matching specific criteria.

sort-data.title: Sort Data
sort-data.text: Sort by one or multiple columns in ascending or descending order.

data-types.title: Data Types
data-types.text: Automatically detect or manually set column data types (numeric, text, date).

correlation-matrix.title: Correlation Matrix
correlation-matrix.text: View correlation coefficients between numeric columns.

distribution-plots.title: Distribution Plots
distribution-plots.text: Visualize data distribution with histograms and box plots.

missing-heatmap.title: Missing Data Heatmap
missing-heatmap.text: Visual representation of missing data patterns across the dataset.

keyboard-shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
keyboard-shortcuts.text: Ctrl+O: Open, Ctrl+S: Save, Ctrl+Z: Undo, Ctrl+Y: Redo, Delete: Clear cell.

file-formats.title: Supported Formats
file-formats.text: CSV, TSV, and Excel files. Auto-detect delimiter and encoding.

encoding-options.title: Text Encoding
encoding-options.text: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, Windows-1252. Auto-detect or manually specify.

delimiter-options.title: Delimiter Options
delimiter-options.text: Comma, tab, semicolon, pipe, or custom delimiter for CSV files.
